field.name: useCustomTitle
field.comment: true: the block displays titleText; false: it displays the name of the page

field.name: useFilterTitle
field.comment: true: the title becomes what the page list blocks of the page are filtered by; false: it stays the same for everyone

field.name: useFilterTopic
field.comment: true: the title becomes the topic the page lists are filtered by, cased as topicTextFormat says; false: the topic is ignored

field.name: useFilterTag
field.comment: true: the title becomes the tag the page lists are filtered by, cased as tagTextFormat says; false: the tag is ignored

field.name: useFilterDate
field.comment: true: the title becomes the date the page lists are filtered by, formatted with filterDateFormat; false: the date is ignored

field.name: topicTextFormat
field.comment: empty: the topic becomes the title as it is; upperWord: every word is capitalized; upperFirst: only the first one is; lowercase: it's lowercased; uppercase: it's uppercased

field.name: tagTextFormat
field.comment: empty: the tag becomes the title as it is; upperWord: every word is capitalized; upperFirst: only the first one is; lowercase: it's lowercased; uppercase: it's uppercased

field.name: dateTextFormat
field.comment: empty: the date becomes the title as it is; upperWord: every word is capitalized; upperFirst: only the first one is; lowercase: it's lowercased; uppercase: it's uppercased

field.name: filterDateFormat
field.comment: A format accepted by the date() PHP function, used for the date that becomes the title (empty: F Y)

field.name: titleText
field.comment: The text displayed instead of the name of the page (used if useCustomTitle is true)

field.name: formatting
field.comment: The HTML element wrapping the title: h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 or p (empty: h1)
